fixes: God Mode CSS grid compressed overflowing sections, hiding inputs and buttons. Replaced by four explicit tab panels and ordinary vertical scrolling.
One layout stylesheet owns floating HUD, dock and panels. Removed their old layout rules from styles.css. Map fills the entire viewport behind controls and safe insets.
God controls use one transaction including persistence; failed save or an intermediate multi-company command rolls back. Success feedback is shown only after success.
Added the opened mobility company to dynamic entity selectors; refreshes company names/balances on open. Removed duplicate workspaceBack ID.
Switching to another section closes God Mode, preventing hidden drawers underneath.
Automatic budget split now preserves the exact input total, assigning rounding remainder to the last category.
limits: Validated in Chromium, with emulated safe insets and multiple landscape sizes, plus portrait regression checks.
Native binaries are reused from the verified 331 IPA; only CFBundleVersion changes outside WebApp.
